title: Training and evaluation data must be separated before feat

metadata.classification_notes: Phase 36 AI Engineering reviewed knowledge; UI tree and canonical node are inherited from candidate classification. Trading rule bodies must remain in Trading Engineering.

applies_when: Building or auditing LLM training, RAG, MCP, evaluation, or governance for trade quality scoring/gating assistants.
not_applicable_when: The task asks for concrete trading entries, exits, position sizing, account-specific settings, or live order execution.

content.statement: Training and evaluation data must be separated before feature selection, transforms, prompt/example selection, or model tuning to avoid contamination and optimistic metrics.
content.rationale: This candidate is scoped to AI Engineering governance for LLM trade quality scoring/gating systems. It does not define trading signals, order execution rules, or strategy parameters. 审计结论：方向充分成立，statement 与 normalized_claim 对齐。训练与评估数据必须在特征选择、transform、prompt/example selection、model tuning 前分离；否则会造成 contamination 和 optimistic metrics。scikit-learn 官方文档直接支持该规则。
procedure: 确认项目事实匹配 applies_when，且没有命中 not_applicable_when。
按 source_patch_notes 检查来源是否足够支撑 statement。
按 content_patch_notes 补齐正式实现、schema、字段和 checklist。
按 boundary_patch_notes 确认没有把交易规则本体、项目私有参数或实盘执行规则写入 AI Engineering。
保留 required_followups，后续由来源增强或治理任务继续关闭。

source_evidence.source_title: Common pitfalls and recommended practices: Data leakage
source_evidence.evidence_summary: scikit-learn warns that data leakage makes evaluation overly optimistic and recommends splitting train/test before fitting transforms.
scikit-learn documents evaluation with held-out data and warns against repeated test-set tuning.
